title: Materi 3.1.1: Pengenalan Synonym dalam Konteks
content:
Materi 3.1.1: Pengenalan Synonym dalam KonteksSynonym bukan cuma soal hafalan kata! Ini tentang pemahaman konteks, kepekaan terhadap nuansa makna, dan kemampuan berpikir fleksibel dalam memahami berbagai makna kata bahasa Inggris.Apa Itu Synonym dan Mengapa Penting?

Bayangin kamu lagi ngobrol sama teman, terus dia bilang "Wah, filmnya brilliant banget!" Nah, kamu langsung ngerti kan maksudnya? Kira-kira sama dengan "amazing", "excellent", atau "outstanding". Nah, itulah synonym—kata-kata yang punya makna mirip atau hampir sama.

Tapi tunggu dulu! Di dunia SNBT, synonym nggak sesederhana itu. Kenapa? Karena konteks is the king!

Coba lihat kata "light" ini:

"The room was filled with light." → cahaya"This bag is very light." → ringan"Can you light the candle?" → menyalakan

Tuh kan? Satu kata bisa punya banyak arti tergantung di mana dan bagaimana dia dipakai. Makanya, dalam soal SNBT, kamu WAJIB baca konteks kalimatnya, bukan cuma apal arti kata dari kamus doang.

Polysemy: Satu Kata, Sejuta MaknaIni dia musuh bebuyutan peserta SNBT: polysemy—fenomena di mana satu kata punya beberapa arti berbeda. Kata-kata kayak gini sering banget jadi jebakan empuk di soal synonym.

Contoh klasik dengan kata "Run":

KalimatArti"I run every morning."berlari"She runs a successful business."mengelola"The program runs smoothly."berjalan/beroperasi"The paint started to run down the wall."meleleh

Nah, kalau soalnya nanya "The word 'run' in line 5 is closest in meaning to...", kamu HARUS baca kalimat line 5 itu dulu. Jangan langsung jawab "sprint" atau "jog" kalau ternyata konteksnya tentang bisnis!

Context is Everything!Ini mantra yang harus kamu hafal: "Arti sebuah kata 100% tergantung konteksnya."

Bayangkan kamu dapat soal kayak gini:

"The company decided to address the environmental concerns raised by local communities."

Nah, "address" di sini artinya apa?

  • BUKAN "alamat" ❌
  • BUKAN "menyapa" ❌
  • TAPI "menangani/menghadapi" ✅

Kalau kamu cuma apal "address = alamat", langsung salah deh!

Tips Jitu Memahami KonteksBaca kalimat lengkap yang mengandung kata tersebutBaca kalimat sebelum dan sesudahnya untuk konteks lebih luasPahami topik paragrafnya secara umumPerhatikan kata-kata di sekitarnya (collocation)Jebakan Umum dalam Soal Synonym SNBTJebakan #1: Arti Paling Familiar Bukan Selalu Benar

Contoh kata "present":

  • Arti familiar: hadiah 🎁
  • Tapi bisa juga: sekarang (the present moment), menghadirkan (present a paper), hadir (be present)

Kalau soalnya: "The researcher will present his findings next week."

Synonym-nya bukan "gift" dong, tapi "show" atau "demonstrate"!

Jebakan #2: Kata yang Kelihatan Mirip

Ini nih yang sering ngejebak:

Kata PertamaArtiKata MiripArtiEffecthasilAffectmempengaruhiComplimentpujianComplementpelengkapPrincipalkepala sekolah/utamaPrincipleprinsip/aturan

Satu huruf beda, artinya beda jauh!

Jebakan #3: Register/Tingkat Formalitas

Kadang ada beberapa kata yang artinya mirip tapi tingkat formalitasnya beda:

Start (informal) = Commence (formal)Buy (informal) = Purchase (formal)Help (informal) = Assist (formal)

Dalam teks akademik SNBT, biasanya yang dipilih adalah yang formal. Jadi kalau ada pilihan "commence" vs "start", dan teksnya formal, pilih yang "commence".

Part of Speech Matters!Ini penting banget: synonym yang kamu pilih HARUS sama part of speech-nya dengan kata asli.

Misalnya kata "significant" (adjective):

✅ Important (adjective) → BENAR❌ Significance (noun) → SALAH, beda kelas kata❌ Significantly (adverb) → SALAH, beda kelas kata

Quick reference:

Part of SpeechPenjelasanContohNounkata bendaperson, idea, concept, developmentVerbkata kerjadevelop, increase, demonstrate, analyzeAdjectivekata sifatimportant, significant, major, criticalAdverbkata keteranganimportantly, significantly, majorly, critically
Variasi Pertanyaan Synonym dalam SNBT

Kenali berbagai bentuk pertanyaan biar nggak kaget waktu ujian:

"The word '...' in line X is closest in meaning to...""The word '...' could be best replaced by...""Which of the following has a similar meaning with '...'?""The word '...' in paragraph 2 is synonymous with...""What is the meaning of '...' as used in line X?"

Semua pertanyaan di atas pada dasarnya nanya hal yang sama: synonym!

Strategy Checklist untuk Synonym QuestionsIkuti langkah-langkah sistematis ini untuk menjawab soal synonym dengan akurat dan percaya diri.Langkah 1: Baca kalimat yang mengandung kata tersebut secara lengkapLangkah 2: Baca kalimat sebelum dan sesudahnya untuk konteksLangkah 3: Identifikasi part of speech kata tersebut (noun/verb/adj/adv)Langkah 4: Coba ganti kata tersebut dengan opsi jawaban satu per satuLangkah 5: Pilih yang paling pas secara makna DAN gramatikalPro Tip: Kalau kamu nggak familiar dengan kata yang ditanyakan, JANGAN PANIK! Fokus ke konteks kalimatnya. Kadang kamu bisa nebak arti dari situation atau topic yang dibahas.Hubungan Synonym dengan Topik Lain

Synonym ini ibarat fondasi untuk memahami materi lain:

Paraphrase itu pada dasarnya menggunakan synonym + perubahan struktur kalimat. Kalau kamu jago synonym, paraphrase jadi lebih gampang!Sering banget informasi di opsi jawaban di-paraphrase dengan synonym. Jadi kalau kamu nggak ngerti synonymnya, bisa miss jawabannya.Banyak synonym yang dipilih berdasarkan register formal/informal. Ini juga dibahas lebih dalam di Materi 3.1.5.Fun Fact: Kenapa Bahasa Inggris Punya Banyak Synonym?Tahukah kamu kalau bahasa Inggris itu "rakus"? Dia suka banget nyerap kata dari bahasa lain! Makanya banyak banget kata dengan arti mirip tapi asal-usul berbeda.ArtiOld English (Informal)Latin/French (Formal)MembantuHelpAssist / AidBertanyaAskInquire / Question

Biasanya yang dari Old English lebih informal/casual, yang dari Latin/French lebih formal/academic. Makanya dalam teks SNBT yang akademis, sering muncul kata-kata Latin-based.

RangkumanSynonym bukan cuma tentang hafalan! Ini tentang pemahaman konteks, kepekaan terhadap nuansa makna, dan kemampuan berpikir fleksibel. Dengan latihan yang cukup, kamu bakal bisa "feeling" mana synonym yang tepat bahkan untuk kata yang baru pertama kali kamu lihat.

title: Materi 3.1.2: Analisis Synonym dari Context Clues
content:
Materi 3.1.2: Analisis Synonym dari Context CluesContext Clues: Senjata Rahasiamu!

Pernah nggak sih kamu baca teks bahasa Inggris, terus ketemu kata yang nggak kamu tau artinya, tapi entah kenapa kamu bisa "nebak" artinya? Nah, itu namanya kamu lagi pakai context clues tanpa sadar!

Context clues itu kayak petunjuk tersembunyi dalam teks yang membantu kamu memahami arti kata yang nggak familiar. Ini skill SUPER PENTING buat SNBT!

Kenapa context clues penting banget?

Hemat waktu – nggak perlu mikir keras atau ragu-raguNggak perlu kamus – teksnya sendiri yang kasih clueLebih akurat – arti sesuai konteks spesifik, bukan arti umum

Mari kita bedah satu per satu jenis context clues yang paling sering muncul!

1. DEFINITION CLUES (Petunjuk Definisi)Ini yang paling gampang! Penulis langsung kasih definisi atau penjelasan dari kata yang mungkin asing.Penanda Khas Definition CluesPenandaContoh Kalimatis/arePhotosynthesis is the process by which plants convert sunlight into energy.meansResilient means able to recover quickly from difficulties.refers toDeforestation refers to the clearing of forests on a massive scale.is defined asAltruism is defined as selfless concern for others.in other wordsThe experiment failed, in other words, it didn't work.that isThe fauna, that is, the animal life of the region, is diverse.
Contoh Analisis

Perhatikan contoh kalimat berikut:

"The scientists observed bioluminescence, which is the emission of light by living organisms, in the deep ocean."

Nah, kalau kamu nggak tau "bioluminescence", langsung dikasih tau kan: "the emission of light by living organisms"!Trik PraktisKalau ketemu kata sulit diikuti tanda koma + "which is/are", "or", "that is", atau dash (—), biasanya itu definition clue!Baca terus aja, pasti dikasih penjelasanJangan skip tanda baca – mereka itu petunjuk penting!2. EXAMPLE CLUES (Petunjuk Contoh)Kadang penulis nggak kasih definisi langsung, tapi kasih contoh-contoh yang bisa bikin kamu paham.Penanda Khas Example CluesPenandaContoh Kalimatsuch asCitrus fruits such as oranges, lemons, and grapefruits...for exampleRenewable energy sources, for example, solar and wind power...for instanceVarious artifacts, for instance, pottery and tools, were found.likePredators like lions, tigers, and wolves...includingMany factors, including age, diet, and lifestyle...
Contoh dalam Teks

"The patient exhibited severe symptoms of the disease, such as high fever, fatigue, and difficulty breathing."

Dari contoh-contoh gejala (high fever, fatigue, difficulty breathing), kamu bisa simpulkan:

  • "exhibited" berarti "menunjukkan"
  • "symptoms" berarti "gejala"

Contoh lagi:

"The garden was filled with fragrant flowers, like roses, jasmine, and lavender."

Meskipun kamu nggak tau "fragrant", dari contohnya (roses, jasmine, lavender) yang notabene bunga-bunga yang wangi, kamu bisa simpulkan "fragrant" berarti "harum/wangi".Pro TipKalau ada kata sulit + "such as/for example/like" + daftar contoh konkret, analyze contoh-contohnya! Cari kesamaan karakteristik dari contoh-contoh tersebut untuk deduce arti kata sulit tadi.3. CONTRAST CLUES (Petunjuk Kontras)Ini agak tricky tapi powerful! Kalau ada kata yang kontras/berlawanan dengan kata yang kita tau, kita bisa inference artinya.Penanda Khas Contrast CluesPenandaFungsiContohbutMenunjukkan kontras langsungShe's usually shy, but today she was quite gregarious.howeverKontras formalThe first attempt failed; however, the second was successful.although/thoughMeskipun/walaupunAlthough he was affluent, he lived modestly.unlikeTidak sepertiUnlike her meticulous sister, Jane is rather careless.on the other handDi sisi lainSome prefer urban life; on the other hand, others love rural settings.whereasSedangkanWhereas the north is arid, the south is quite humid.instead ofAlih-alih/daripadaInstead of being lethargic, the team was energetic.rather thanDaripadaHe chose to collaborate rather than compete.
Contoh Analisis

"Unlike his gregarious brother who loves parties, Tom is quite introverted."

"Gregarious" di-contrast-kan dengan "introverted" (introvert/pemalu)Jadi bisa disimpulkan "gregarious" itu kebalikannyaKesimpulan: "gregarious" = ekstrovert/suka bergaul!

Contoh lagi:

"The first solution was complicated and time-consuming. In contrast, the new method is remarkably facile."

"Facile" di-kontras-kan dengan "complicated" (rumit). Jadi "facile" artinya = simple/mudah!Hati-hati!Jangan cuma fokus sama contrast word-nya. Perhatikan juga APA yang di-contrast-kan. Kadang yang kontras itu bukan kata yang ditanyakan, tapi kata lain dalam kalimat.4. RESTATEMENT CLUES (Petunjuk Pengulangan)Penulis ngulang ide yang sama tapi dengan kata berbeda. Biasanya ada penanda kayak "or", "that is", "in other words".Penanda Khas Restatement CluesPenandaContoh PenggunaanorThe physician, or doctor, will see you now.that isShe's an ornithologist, that is, a bird expert.in other wordsHe's parsimonious, in other words, very stingy with money.i.e.The lab uses H₂O, i.e., water, in the experiment.
Contoh dalam Teks

"The archipelago, or group of islands, stretches for hundreds of miles."

"Archipelago" langsung dijelaskan dengan "group of islands"!

Contoh lagi:

"The CEO decided to divest, that is, sell off some company assets."

"Divest" dijelaskan ulang dengan "sell off some company assets".

Bonus TrickKadang restatement pakai tanda baca comma (,) atau dash (—) tanpa kata penanda. Contoh: "The teacher emphasized the importance of tenacity — persistence in pursuing goals."5. INFERENCE FROM GENERAL CONTEXTIni yang paling challenging tapi juga paling sering dipake! Kadang nggak ada clue eksplisit, tapi dari keseluruhan situasi, topik, atau tone kamu bisa nebak artinya.Contoh 1: Dari Situasi

"After hiking for six hours without water under the scorching sun, they were completely parched."

Situasi: hiking lama, no water, hot sunLogikanya: mereka kehausan/haus bangetKesimpulan: "parched" = sangat kehausanContoh 2: Dari Topik/Subject Matter

"In marine biology, researchers study the fauna of coral reefs, including colorful fish and invertebrates."

Konteks: marine biology + coral reefsContoh: fish dan invertebratesKesimpulan: "fauna" pasti tentang animal lifeContoh 3: Dari Tone

"Despite facing numerous obstacles, she remained undaunted and continued her research."

Tone: positif (she continued despite obstacles)Kesimpulan: "undaunted" pasti something positive = tidak gentar/tidak menyerahStrategy untuk General ContextTentukan topik umum paragraf (science? economy? social issue?)Pahami situasi atau scenario yang dideskripsikanTemukan logical relationship dengan informasi sekitarPakai common sense dan background knowledge kamuCombining Multiple CluesYang paling powerful adalah kombinasi beberapa clues sekaligus!Contoh Kombinasi

"The manager's decision to terminate the project was laudable; in other words, it was praiseworthy. Unlike previous managers who wasted resources, she made a smart choice."

Banyak clue di sini:

Restatement: "in other words" + "praiseworthy"Contrast: "Unlike previous managers who wasted resources" vs "smart choice"General context: tone positif tentang decisionTriple clue = super clear bahwa "laudable" = pantas dipuji!Common Pitfalls (Jebakan Umum)Pitfall #1: Mengabaikan Konteks Lokal

Jangan cuma fokus ke kata yang ditanyakan. Baca minimal 1 kalimat penuh sebelum dan sesudahnya.

❌ SALAH✅ BENARBaca cuma kalimat yang ada kata "X", langsung tebakBaca 3 kalimat (sebelum, yang mengandung X, sesudah) untuk full context
Pitfall #2: Terjebak dengan Arti yang FamiliarKata seperti "address", "present", "bank", "bear" punya multiple meanings. Jangan auto-pilot ke arti yang paling kamu kenal!

Contoh:

  • Address bisa berarti "alamat" ATAU "menangani/membahas"
  • Present bisa berarti "hadiah" ATAU "mempresentasikan" ATAU "saat ini"
  • Bank bisa berarti "bank" ATAU "tepian sungai"
  • Bear bisa berarti "beruang" ATAU "menanggung/memikul"
Pitfall #3: OverthinkingKadang clue-nya jelas, tapi kamu mikir "ah masa sih segampang ini?" Percaya sama clue yang ada! SNBT nggak selalu jebakan kok.Practice Strategy: The "Cover and Guess" MethodCara latihan yang efektif untuk meningkatkan skill context clues kamu!Langkah-langkah:Cover kata yang ditanyakan dengan jari/kertasBaca kalimat lengkapnya tanpa kata ituGuess kata apa yang kira-kira cocok di posisi ituReveal kata aslinyaCompare apakah tebakan kamu close dengan arti sebenarnyaContoh Praktik

"The discovery was ________, attracting worldwide attention from scientists."

TahapHasilGuess"significant" atau "important" atau "groundbreaking"Reveal"remarkable"EvaluasiTebakan kamu close kan? That's the power of context!
Level Up Your Context Clue SkillsIdentify definition dan example clues → paling obviousRecognize contrast dan restatement clues → butuh sedikit analysisInference from general context → butuh critical thinkingPractice makes perfect! Semakin sering kamu latihan recognize context clues, semakin natural skillnya.Rangkuman: 5 Jenis Context CluesJenisPenanda KhasTingkat KesulitanDefinition Cluesis, means, refers to, is defined as⭐ MudahExample Cluessuch as, for example, like, including⭐ MudahContrast Cluesbut, however, unlike, whereas⭐⭐ SedangRestatement Cluesor, that is, in other words, i.e.⭐⭐ SedangGeneral ContextDari situasi, topik, atau tone keseluruhan⭐⭐⭐ Sulit
Key TakeawayContext clues itu kayak treasure map yang udah disediain sama penulis. Tugas kamu cuma jeli membaca petunjuknya. Don't memorize, ANALYZE!Dengan menguasai context clues, kamu bisa memahami teks bahasa Inggris lebih cepat dan akurat tanpa harus menghapal ribuan vocabulary. Skill ini akan sangat berguna bukan hanya untuk SNBT, tapi juga untuk kehidupan akademis dan profesional kamu ke depannya!

Siap lanjut ke materi selanjutnya tentang kata-kata dengan multiple meanings? Let's go! 🎯

title: Materi 3.1.3: Analisis Multiple Meanings
content:
Materi 3.1.3: Analisis Multiple MeaningsIni adalah zona bahaya favorit pembuat soal SNBT! Kata-kata dengan banyak arti bisa bikin kamu salah kalau nggak hati-hati. Tapi tenang, dengan memahami pola-polanya, kamu bisa tackle dengan mudah!The Tricky World of Multiple Meanings

Okay, sekarang kita masuk ke zona yang paling sering jadi jebakan: kata-kata yang punya lebih dari satu arti! Ini adalah senjata favorit pembuat soal SNBT karena bisa bikin peserta yang nggak hati-hati langsung salah.

Bayangin kamu lihat kata "bank" dalam soal. Langsung kepikiran bank tempat nabung kan? Padahal bisa jadi konteksnya:

  • "They sat on the bank of the river." → tepi sungai
  • "The pilot had to bank the plane to the left." → memiringkan
  • "We bank on your support." → mengandalkan

Tuh kan? Satu kata, banyak banget kemungkinan artinya!

Kata-Kata dengan Multiple Meanings yang Sering Muncul

Mari kita bedah kata-kata yang paling sering jadi jebakan:

1. RUN (Juaranya Multiple Meanings!)Ini kata yang punya 600+ arti di kamus! (No kidding!) Tapi yang sering di SNBT ada beberapa yang harus kamu hafalin.📘 Run = berlari (motion)
"She runs five kilometers every morning."🔮 Run = mengelola/menjalankan (manage/operate)
"He runs a successful restaurant."
"Who runs this organization?"📝 Run = berjalan/beroperasi (function)
"The machine runs smoothly."
"The program runs on Windows."💡 Run = mengalir (flow)
"Tears ran down her cheeks."
"The river runs through the city."✨ Run = meleleh (melt/spread)
"The paint ran down the wall."
"Don't let the colors run in the wash."✅ Run = berlangsung (last/continue)
"The show runs for two hours."
"The contract runs until December."Cara bedain: Lihat subject dan object-nya!
• Subject = person → probably berlari atau mengelola
• Subject = thing/program → probably beroperasi
• Subject = liquid/color → probably mengalir/meleleh2. SET (Close Second dengan 400+ arti!)📘 Set = menempatkan/meletakkan (put/place)
"She set the book on the table."🔮 Set = menetapkan (establish/determine)
"The government set new regulations."
"Let's set a date for the meeting."📝 Set = mengatur (adjust)
"Set your alarm for 6 AM."💡 Set = terbenam (go down – untuk matahari)
"The sun sets at 6 PM."✨ Set = kumpulan/satu set (group of similar items)
"A set of tools"
"A set of dishes"✅ Set = siap (ready)
"Are you all set?"Trik: Perhatikan preposition setelah "set"!
• Set on → put on a surface
• Set up → establish/organize
• Set out → begin a journey3. LIGHT📘 Light = cahaya (brightness)
"Turn on the light."
"The room is filled with natural light."🔮 Light = ringan (not heavy)
"This suitcase is very light."
"She prefers light meals."💡 Light = menyalakan (ignite)
"Can you light the candles?"📝 Light = cerah/terang (pale)
"She wore a light blue dress."✨ Light = enteng/tidak serius (not serious)
"Let's keep the conversation light."
"It's just light reading."Cara bedain: Check part of speech!
• Noun → cahaya atau sesuatu yang menghasilkan cahaya
• Adjective → ringan, cerah, atau tidak serius
• Verb → menyalakan4. FAIR📘 Fair = adil (just/equitable)
"The judge made a fair decision."🔮 Fair = lumayan/cukup baik (reasonably good)
"He has a fair chance of winning."
"Her English is fair." (= cukup baik, not excellent)💡 Fair = cerah/terang (light-colored)
"She has fair skin."
"Fair hair" (= rambut pirang)✨ Fair = pameran/festival (exhibition)
"We went to the book fair."
"The science fair is next week."Context is key:
• Tentang keadilan/justice → fair = adil
• Tentang kualitas/kemampuan → fair = lumayan
• Tentang appearance → fair = cerah/terang
• Noun form → pameran5. PRESENT📘 Present = hadiah (gift)
"She gave me a birthday present."🔮 Present = sekarang/saat ini (current time)
"Let's focus on the present moment."
"All members are present at the meeting." (= hadir)💡 Present = menghadirkan/menyajikan (show/demonstrate)
"He will present his research findings."
"The company presented a new product."📝 Present = memberikan secara formal (give formally)
"The dean will present the awards."Pro tip:
• Kalau ada context gift-giving → hadiah
• Kalau ada context showing/explaining → menyajikan/menghadirkan
• Kalau tentang time → sekarang/saat ini
• Kalau tentang attendance → hadir6. ADDRESS📘 Address = alamat (location)
"What's your home address?"🔮 Address = menangani/menghadapi (deal with)
"The government needs to address this issue."
"We must address the problems immediately."💡 Address = menyapa/berbicara kepada (speak to)
"The president will address the nation."
"How should I address you?" (= memanggil Anda)Quick check:
• Noun form + physical location → alamat
• Verb + problem/issue → menangani
• Verb + person/audience → berbicara kepada7. BEAR📘 Bear = beruang (animal)
"A grizzly bear approached."🔮 Bear = menanggung/menahan (endure/tolerate)
"I can't bear the pain."
"She bears the responsibility."💡 Bear = melahirkan/menghasilkan (give birth/produce)
"The tree bears fruit."
"She bore three children."📝 Bear = membawa (carry – formal)
"Bear this in mind." (= ingat ini)Context matters:
• Animal context → beruang
• Pain/responsibility/burden → menanggung
• Children/fruit/results → melahirkan/menghasilkan8. POINT📘 Point = titik/poin (dot/mark)
"Put a point at the end."🔮 Point = poin/skor (score)
"Our team scored 10 points."💡 Point = hal penting/inti (main idea/purpose)
"What's your point?"
"The point is we need to act now."📝 Point = menunjuk (indicate direction)
"She pointed to the door."✨ Point = menunjukkan/mengindikasikan (suggest/show)
"The evidence points to his guilt."Strategi Menghadapi Multiple MeaningsGunakan strategi 4 langkah ini untuk menentukan arti yang tepat dari kata dengan multiple meanings!Step 1: Identify Part of Speech

Ini langkah PERTAMA dan PALING PENTING!

  • Noun? Fokus ke arti "benda" atau "konsep"
  • Verb? Fokus ke arti "aksi" atau "proses"
  • Adjective? Fokus ke arti "sifat" atau "kualitas"
Contoh:

• "The light in the room was dim." → NOUN → cahaya
• "Please light the fire." → VERB → menyalakan
• "The bag is light." → ADJECTIVE → ringanStep 2: Check the Subject and Object

Subjek dan objek sering kasih clue penting!

KalimatAnalisisArti"The company runs three factories."Subject: company (organization)
Object: factoriesmengelola ✅
(bukan "berlari" ❌)"The river runs through the valley."Subject: river (water body)
Through: valley (place)mengalir ✅
Step 3: Look for Prepositions

Preposition setelah verb often changes meaning dramatically!

📘 Run out = kehabisan🔮 Run into = bertemu secara kebetulan atau menabrak💡 Run over = menabrak dengan kendaraan📝 Run through = melewati atau memeriksa cepat✨ Run up = menimbulkan (hutang/biaya)Beda preposition, beda arti! Jangan anggap sepele kata-kata kecil seperti on, up, out, through!Step 4: Consider the Topic/Field

Different fields use same words differently:

KataContextArtiCurrentGeneral contextsekarang/terkiniElectricity contextarus listrikWater contextarus airCellBiologyselPrison contextsel tahananPhone contexttelepon seluler
Red Flags: Warning Signs of Multiple MeaningsWaspadai tanda-tanda ini saat mengerjakan soal!Kata pendek dan umum

Kata-kata seperti get, set, run, make, take usually punya banyak arti. Extra hati-hati!Bisa jadi berbagai POS

Kata seperti light, present, address bisa noun, verb, atau adjective. Check dulu POS-nya!Technical vs General

Kata "cell", "current", "field" artinya bisa beda banget tergantung context academic atau general.Common Mistakes to Avoid❗ Mistake #1: Auto-pilot ke arti paling familiar

Contoh SALAH:
"The company will present a new proposal."
Salah pikir: "present = hadiah"

Harusnya: analyze dulu → subject "company" + verb "present" + object "proposal" → pasti "menyajikan/menghadirkan"❗ Mistake #2: Ignore context sepenuhnya

Contoh SALAH:
"The solution is fair."
Salah pikir: "fair = pameran"

Harusnya: context tentang solution → tidak mungkin pameran → pasti "adil" atau "cukup baik"❗ Mistake #3: Tidak check POS

Contoh SALAH:
"Turn on the light." (NOUN)
Synonym: "bright" (ADJECTIVE) ❌

Harusnya: light (noun) → lamp, illumination (noun juga) ✅Practice Technique: The Substitution MethodCara test apakah synonym kamu benar dengan metode substitusi!

Ikuti langkah-langkah ini:

  1. Ganti kata asli dengan synonym pilihan kamu
  2. Baca ulang kalimatnya
  3. Does it make sense? Grammar-nya benar? Meaning-nya sama?
Contoh Praktik:

Original: "She runs a small business."

Test 1: "She jogs a small business." → ❌ Doesn't make sense

Test 2: "She operates a small business." → ✅ Makes perfect sense!The Ultimate Checklist untuk Multiple MeaningsSetiap kali ketemu kata yang potentially punya multiple meanings, gunakan checklist ini!📝 Step 1: Apa POS-nya? (noun/verb/adj/adv)📝 Step 2: Siapa subject-nya? Apa object-nya?📝 Step 3: Ada preposition nggak? (affect meaning?)📝 Step 4: Topik/field apa yang dibahas?📝 Step 5: Test pilihan synonym dengan substitution method

Follow checklist ini = minimize chances of error!

Level Up: Homographs vs Homophones vs HomonymsBonus knowledge buat yang mau deep dive tentang jenis-jenis kata yang mirip!TipeKarakteristikContohHomographsSpelling sama, pronunciation bisa beda, meaning beda• Read (present: /riːd/) vs Read (past: /red/)
• Lead (to guide: /liːd/) vs Lead (metal: /led/)HomophonesPronunciation sama, spelling beda, meaning beda• Their / There / They're
• To / Too / Two
• Right / WriteHomonymsUmbrella term untuk kata dengan spelling/pronunciation sama tapi meaning bedaIncludes homographs
Di SNBT, yang paling sering adalah polysemy (satu kata dengan related multiple meanings) dan homonyms.Rangkuman & Key MindsetJangan takut sama kata-kata dengan multiple meanings! They're actually predictable kalau kamu tau pola-polanya.

Context + POS + Logic = Answer!Kata-kata yang wajib diwaspadai:

• RUN (600+ meanings!)
• SET (400+ meanings!)
• LIGHT, FAIR, PRESENT
• ADDRESS, BEAR, POINT

Selalu check: POS → Subject/Object → Preposition → Context!Dengan memahami strategi dan pola-pola di atas, kamu sudah punya senjata lengkap untuk menghadapi jebakan multiple meanings di SNBT. Practice makes perfect – semakin sering latihan, semakin cepat kamu bisa identify arti yang tepat!

title: Materi 3.1.4: Analisis Synonym untuk Different Word Classes
content:
Materi 3.1.4: Analisis Synonym untuk Different Word ClassesWord Class Matters: Kenapa Part of Speech Itu Crucial?

Okay, bayangin kamu disuruh cari synonym dari kata "develop" (verb). Terus kamu jawab "development" (noun). Salah dong! Meskipun artinya related, tapi beda kelas katanya.

Ini adalah GOLDEN RULE dalam soal synonym SNBT:

Synonym yang kamu pilih HARUS SATU KELAS KATA dengan kata aslinya! Verb harus diganti verb, noun harus diganti noun, adjective harus diganti adjective, adverb harus diganti adverb.

Simple? IYA! Tapi banyak yang lupa dan kena jebakan.

Quick Refresher: 4 Major Word ClassesNOUN (Kata Benda) - Menyatakan orang, tempat, benda, atau konsep. Bisa jadi subject atau object dalam kalimat. Contoh: person, idea, development, happinessVERB (Kata Kerja) - Menyatakan aksi atau keadaan. Inti dari predicate. Contoh: develop, increase, demonstrate, analyzeADJECTIVE (Kata Sifat) - Mendeskripsikan atau memodifikasi noun. Menjawab pertanyaan "what kind?" atau "which one?". Contoh: important, significant, major, criticalADVERB (Kata Keterangan) - Memodifikasi verb, adjective, atau adverb lain. Sering (tapi tidak selalu) berakhiran -ly. Contoh: importantly, significantly, quickly, veryNOUN SYNONYMSPattern Recognition untuk Nouns

Noun synonyms biasanya lebih straightforward karena merujuk ke concrete things atau abstract concepts.

Common Noun Pairs
  • person = individual, human being
  • expert = specialist, professional, authority
  • leader = director, manager, head, chief
  • worker = employee, staff member, laborer
  • student = learner, pupil, scholar
  • problem = issue, challenge, difficulty, obstacle
  • idea = concept, notion, thought, proposal
  • method = approach, technique, strategy, way
  • result = outcome, consequence, effect, finding
  • goal = objective, aim, target, purpose
  • growth = development, expansion, increase, progress
  • change = alteration, modification, transformation, shift
  • improvement = enhancement, betterment, advancement, upgrade
  • importance = significance, relevance, consequence, weight
  • difference = distinction, disparity, variation, contrast
  • advantage = benefit, merit, plus, strength
  • disadvantage = drawback, downside, weakness, flaw
Strategi Identifikasi Noun SynonymsClue #1: Position dalam kalimat - Noun biasanya ada di: Setelah artikel (a, an, the): "the problem", Setelah possessive (my, your, his, her): "his idea", Setelah adjective: "important factor", Sebagai subject: "The study shows...", Sebagai object: "They discussed the issue."Clue #2: Determiner test - Kalau bisa ditambah "a/an/the" di depannya, kemungkinan besar noun: ✅ "a/the person", ✅ "an/the idea", ✅ "the problem"Clue #3: Pluralization - Kalau bisa dibuat plural (tambah -s/-es), itu noun: person → persons/people, idea → ideas, problem → problemsJebakan Umum dengan Noun SynonymsJebakan #1: Word Family Trap

Kata: "The significance of this discovery..."

  • ❌ SALAH: significant (adjective)
  • ❌ SALAH: significantly (adverb)
  • ✅ BENAR: importance (noun)
Jebakan #2: Similar Spelling Different POS

Kata: "The development of technology..."

  • ❌ SALAH: develop (verb)
  • ❌ SALAH: developmental (adjective)
  • ✅ BENAR: advancement (noun), progress (noun)
VERB SYNONYMSPattern Recognition untuk Verbs

Verbs express actions, states, or occurrences. Identifying verb synonyms butuh perhatian khusus ke tense dan form.

Common Verb Pairs
  • show = demonstrate, display, exhibit, reveal, indicate
  • explain = clarify, elucidate, describe, illustrate
  • say = state, mention, declare, assert, express
  • tell = inform, notify, advise, instruct
  • increase = rise, grow, expand, escalate, surge
  • decrease = decline, fall, drop, diminish, reduce
  • develop = evolve, progress, advance, grow, mature
  • change = alter, modify, transform, convert, shift
  • examine = analyze, investigate, inspect, study, scrutinize
  • find = discover, detect, identify, locate, uncover
  • prove = demonstrate, verify, confirm, validate, establish
  • suggest = indicate, imply, propose, recommend, hint
  • cause = produce, generate, create, bring about, lead to
  • affect = influence, impact, alter, modify, change
  • help = assist, aid, support, facilitate, enable
  • continue = proceed, persist, carry on, maintain, sustain
  • keep = maintain, retain, preserve, hold, sustain
Strategi Identifikasi Verb SynonymsClue #1: Position dalam kalimat - Verbs biasanya: Setelah subject: "The study shows...", Dengan helping verb: "will demonstrate", "has increased", Dengan "to": "to explain", "to develop"Clue #2: Tense test - Kalau bisa diubah ke past tense (-ed atau irregular), itu verb: show → showed, increase → increased, find → foundClue #3: Progressive test - Kalau bisa ditambah -ing untuk continuous form, itu verb: explaining, developing, increasing, showingJebakan Umum dengan Verb SynonymsJebakan #1: Noun Form yang Mirip

Kata: "The research demonstrates the effectiveness..."

  • ❌ SALAH: demonstration (noun)
  • ✅ BENAR: shows (verb), proves (verb)
Jebakan #2: Adjective Form yang Deceptive

Kata: "The data indicates a trend..."

  • ❌ SALAH: indicative (adjective)
  • ✅ BENAR: suggests (verb), shows (verb)
Jebakan #3: Tense Consistency

Hati-hati! Synonym harus compatible dengan tense yang dipakai:

Contoh: "The study showed significant results."

  • ✅ demonstrated (past)
  • ❌ demonstrate (present)
ADJECTIVE SYNONYMSPattern Recognition untuk Adjectives

Adjectives describe atau modify nouns. They answer "what kind?", "which one?", "how many?"

Common Adjective Pairs
  • large = big, huge, substantial, considerable, extensive
  • small = little, tiny, minor, slight, minimal
  • important = significant, crucial, vital, essential, critical
  • good = excellent, fine, superior, favorable, beneficial
  • bad = poor, inferior, unfavorable, negative, detrimental
  • difficult = hard, challenging, tough, complex, demanding
  • easy = simple, straightforward, effortless, uncomplicated
  • new = novel, recent, modern, fresh, contemporary
  • old = ancient, aged, outdated, traditional, former
  • major = significant, substantial, considerable, primary, principal
  • minor = small, insignificant, trivial, negligible, slight
  • complete = total, full, entire, comprehensive, absolute
  • common = frequent, widespread, prevalent, usual, typical
  • rare = uncommon, unusual, scarce, infrequent, exceptional
Strategi Identifikasi Adjective SynonymsClue #1: Position dalam kalimat - Adjectives biasanya: Sebelum noun: "an important factor", Setelah be/linking verb: "is significant", "seems difficult"Clue #2: Degree test - Kalau bisa ditambah "very" atau "more/most", biasanya adjective: very important, more significant, very difficult, most challengingClue #3: "-ly" adverb test - Banyak adjective bisa dijadikan adverb dengan tambah -ly: important → importantly, significant → significantly. Tapi hati-hati! Tidak semua kata -ly adalah adverb; "friendly", "lovely" adalah adjectiveJebakan Umum dengan Adjective SynonymsJebakan #1: Adverb yang Kelihatan Mirip

Kata: "This is significant research."

  • ❌ SALAH: significantly (adverb)
  • ✅ BENAR: important (adjective)
Jebakan #2: Noun Form dari Word Family

Kata: "The study reached a critical stage."

  • ❌ SALAH: criticism (noun)
  • ❌ SALAH: critic (noun)
  • ✅ BENAR: crucial (adjective), vital (adjective)
ADVERB SYNONYMSPattern Recognition untuk Adverbs

Adverbs modify verbs, adjectives, atau adverbs lain. Many (but not all) end in -ly.

Common Adverb Pairs
  • quickly = rapidly, swiftly, speedily, fast
  • slowly = gradually, steadily
  • carefully = cautiously, attentively, meticulously
  • easily = effortlessly, readily, simply
  • very = extremely, highly, remarkably, exceedingly, considerably
  • quite = rather, fairly, pretty, somewhat
  • almost = nearly, practically, virtually
  • often = frequently, regularly, commonly, repeatedly
  • rarely = seldom, infrequently, hardly ever
  • always = constantly, continually, invariably, consistently
  • sometimes = occasionally, periodically, at times
  • immediately = instantly, right away, at once, promptly
  • eventually = ultimately, finally, in the end
  • recently = lately, not long ago
  • certainly = definitely, surely, undoubtedly, absolutely
  • probably = likely, presumably, possibly, perhaps
Strategi Identifikasi Adverb SynonymsClue #1: Modifies verb - "The economy grew rapidly." (modifies "grew"), "She speaks fluently." (modifies "speaks")Clue #2: Modifies adjective - "It's extremely important." (modifies "important"), "The result is highly significant." (modifies "significant")Clue #3: Modifies another adverb - "She works very carefully." ("very" modifies "carefully")Clue #4: The -ly pattern - Banyak adverbs dibentuk dari adjective + ly: quick → quickly, significant → significantly, careful → carefully. HATI-HATI: Tidak semua kata -ly adalah adverb! friendly, lovely, lonely → adjectives!Jebakan Umum dengan Adverb SynonymsJebakan #1: Adjective Form

Kata: "The temperature increased significantly."

  • ❌ SALAH: significant (adjective)
  • ✅ BENAR: considerably (adverb), substantially (adverb)
Jebakan #2: Confusion dengan Similar Forms

Kata: "She completed the task efficiently."

  • ❌ SALAH: efficient (adjective)
  • ❌ SALAH: efficiency (noun)
  • ✅ BENAR: effectively (adverb)
CROSS-CHECKING TECHNIQUESetelah pilih synonym, always double-check dengan teknik ini:Step 1: Substitute the word - Ganti kata asli dengan synonym pilihanmu dalam kalimat.Step 2: Read aloud (mentally) - Baca kalimat dengan kata baru. Does it flow naturally?Step 3: Check grammar - Tense-nya cocok? (untuk verb), Plural/singular-nya sesuai? (untuk noun), Agreement-nya benar? (untuk adjective)Step 4: Verify meaning - Arti keseluruhannya tetap sama atau tidak?QUICK REFERENCE GUIDEUntuk identify word class dengan cepat:Word ClassCommon PositionsCommon SuffixesTestsNOUNAfter a/an/the, after adjective, as subject/object-tion, -ment, -ness, -ity, -ance, -enceCan add "the" before itVERBAfter subject, after to, after modals-ify, -ize, -ate, -enCan change tenseADJECTIVEBefore noun, after be/seem/appear-ful, -less, -able, -ive, -ous, -alCan add "very" before itADVERBAfter/before verb, before adjective-ly (most common)Modifies verb/adj/adv
PRACTICE STRATEGYLatihan untuk Master Word Classes:Bikin chart untuk common words dengan semua bentuk POS-nya. Contoh: significance (noun) - signify (verb) - significant (adj) - significantly (adv)Ambil sentences dari reading, identify part of speech setiap kata, practice ganti dengan synonyms yang SAMA POS-nya.Buat intentional errors (wrong POS), lalu correct them. Ini ngelatih awareness kamu terhadap perbedaan word class.Contoh Word Family ChartNounVerbAdjectiveAdverbsignificancesignifysignificantsignificantlydevelopmentdevelopdevelopmentaldevelopmentallyimportance-importantimportantlydifferencedifferdifferentdifferentlyeffectivenesseffecteffectiveeffectively
The Ultimate Rule: Same POS or game over!

Meaning bisa mirip, spelling bisa related, tapi kalau beda part of speech, langsung salah! This is non-negotiable.

Remember: Soal SNBT suka banget ngasih pilihan jawaban yang artinya mirip tapi beda word class. Jangan kena jebakan! Selalu cek POS-nya dulu sebelum pilih synonym.

Ready untuk level up ke academic vocabulary? Let's go! 📚

title: Materi 3.1.5: Analisis Academic Vocabulary dan Register
content:
Materi 3.1.5: Analisis Academic Vocabulary dan RegisterPernah nggak sih kamu baca teks bahasa Inggris casual (kayak chat, sosmed, blog personal) dan rasanya gampang banget? Tapi begitu baca journal article atau teks academic, langsung berasa kayak baca bahasa alien? Nah, itu karena register-nya beda!Apa Itu Register dan Academic Vocabulary?

Register itu level formalitas bahasa yang dipakai. Dalam SNBT, teks-teksnya mostly academic/formal register, jadi kamu harus familiar dengan academic vocabulary—kata-kata formal yang sering muncul di teks ilmiah, penelitian, dan bacaan akademis.

Academic vocabulary adalah kata-kata yang: (1) Formal dan sophisticated, (2) Sering muncul di teks akademik (journal, textbook, research paper), (3) Lintas disiplin (nggak spesifik satu subject, bisa dipake di berbagai field), dan (4) Presisi tinggi (makna lebih spesifik dibanding kata casual)Contoh Perbedaan Casual vs Academic

Coba perhatiin perbedaan kata-kata ini:

Casual/InformalAcademic/Formalgetobtain, acquire, receiveshowdemonstrate, illustrate, indicateuseutilize, employ, applythink aboutconsider, contemplate, examinehelpassist, facilitate, aidstartcommence, initiate, beginendconclude, terminate, finalizebuypurchase, acquire, procuremakecreate, produce, construct, fabricate
Academic Word List: Your Best Friend

Ada yang namanya Academic Word List yang disusun oleh Averil Coxhead—berisi 570 word families yang paling sering muncul di teks akademik across all disciplines.

Berikut ini adalah Top 50 Academic Words yang WAJIB kamu kenal untuk sukses di SNBT!Tier 1: Super Common (Wajib Banget!)analyze – menganalisis atau memeriksa secara detailapproach – metode atau cara melakukan sesuatuassess – mengevaluasi atau menilaiassume – mengasumsikan tanpa bukti pasticoncept – ide atau gagasan abstrakconclude – mencapai kesimpulanconduct – melaksanakan atau menjalankanconsist – terdiri dari atau tersusun atasconstitute – membentuk atau menyusuncontext – konteks atau situasi tertentuTier 2: Very Commoncreate – membuat atau menghasilkandata – fakta atau informasidefine – mendefinisikan dengan jelasderive – memperoleh dari sumber tertentudistribute – menyebarkan atau membagikaneconomy – sistem produksi dan konsumsienvironment – lingkungan sekitarestablish – mendirikan atau menciptakanestimate – perkiraan kasarevident – jelas atau nyataTier 3: Commonfactor – elemen yang berkontribusi pada hasilfunction – tujuan atau peranidentify – mengenali atau menetapkanindicate – menunjukkan atau mengindikasikanindividual – orang atau hal tunggalinterpret – menjelaskan maknainvolve – mencakup atau mengandungissue – topik atau masalah pentingmethod – cara sistematis dalam melakukanoccur – terjadi atau berlangsungTier 4: Frequentpercent – tingkat per seratusperiod – rentang waktupolicy – kebijakan atau tindakanprinciple – kebenaran fundamentalproceed – melanjutkan atau majuprocess – serangkaian tindakanrequire – membutuhkanresearch – investigasi sistematisrespond – bereaksi atau membalasrole – fungsi atau bagian yang dimainkanTier 5: Regularsection – bagian yang berbedasignificant – penting atau bermaknasimilar – mirip atau sebandingsource – asal atau titik awalspecific – tepat atau khususstructure – susunan atau organisasitheory – penjelasan berdasarkan prinsipvary – berbeda atau berubahachieve – mencapai atau menyelesaikanacquire – memperoleh atau mendapatkanKenapa Academic Vocabulary Penting untuk SNBT?Semua bacaan di SNBT—baik teks saintek, soshum, maupun umum—ditulis dengan academic register. Kalau kamu cuma familiar dengan casual vocabulary, bakal struggle parah.Opsi jawaban dalam soal synonym biasanya menggunakan kata-kata academic yang maintain formal register. Kamu harus bisa recognize mana yang paling tepat!Kalau kamu familiar dengan academic vocab, reading jadi lebih cepat. Nggak perlu ngos-ngosan translate tiap kata karena udah langsung paham.Register Levels: Dari Casual sampai Ultra-Formal

Mari kita lihat satu konsep yang diekspresikan dalam berbagai register:

Konsep: Menunjukkan informasi atau buktiRegister LevelVocabulary ChoiceCasual/Slang"This stuff shows that..."Informal"This shows that..."Neutral"This indicates that..."Formal"This demonstrates that..."Very Formal/Academic"This illustrates/reveals that..."Ultra Formal/Archaic"This evinces that..."
Dalam SNBT, expect level Neutral sampai Formal/Academic. Jadi kamu harus nyaman dengan kata-kata di level tersebut!Formal vs Informal Synonyms

Ini dia yang harus kamu master untuk sukses di SNBT:

Common VerbsInformalFormal/Academicgetobtain, acquire, receive, securegiveprovide, supply, furnish, presentgo upincrease, rise, escalate, surgego downdecrease, decline, diminish, dropmakecreate, produce, generate, constructdoperform, conduct, execute, undertakefind outdiscover, ascertain, determine, identifylook atexamine, observe, investigate, scrutinizethink aboutconsider, contemplate, ponder, reflect ontalk aboutdiscuss, address, explore, examine
Common AdjectivesInformalFormal/Academicbiglarge, substantial, considerable, significantsmallminor, minimal, negligible, insignificantgoodbeneficial, advantageous, favorable, positivebaddetrimental, adverse, negative, unfavorableimportantsignificant, crucial, vital, essential, criticalharddifficult, challenging, demanding, complexeasysimple, straightforward, uncomplicated, elementarynewnovel, recent, contemporary, innovativeoldprevious, former, prior, antiquateda lot ofnumerous, considerable, substantial, abundant
Common NounsInformalFormal/Academicthingelement, factor, aspect, componentstuffmaterial, substance, matterproblemissue, challenge, difficulty, obstaclechanceopportunity, possibility, prospectpartcomponent, element, segment, portionwaymethod, approach, technique, strategyjobtask, responsibility, function, role
Common AdverbsInformalFormal/Academica lotconsiderably, substantially, significantlyreallyexceedingly, remarkably, notablyveryhighly, extremely, particularlymaybeperhaps, possibly, potentiallyalsoadditionally, furthermore, moreoverbuthowever, nevertheless, nonethelesssotherefore, thus, consequently, hence
Denotation vs Connotation: Subtle tapi PentingDenotation = makna literal menurut kamus. Connotation = asosiasi emosional atau budaya yang terkait dengan kata tersebut.

Mari kita lihat beberapa contoh:

Contoh 1: "Cheap" vs "Inexpensive"Denotation: Kedua-duanya = harga rendahConnotation "Cheap": Negatif (kualitas buruk, murahan)Connotation "Inexpensive": Neutral/Positif (terjangkau, affordable)Contoh 2: "Skinny" vs "Slender" vs "Thin"Denotation: Semua = tidak gemukConnotation "Skinny": Negatif (terlalu kurus, unhealthy)Connotation "Thin": Neutral (kurus secara objektif)Connotation "Slender": Positif (langsing dengan kesan graceful)Dalam SNBT: Academic texts prefer words dengan neutral atau positive connotation. Jadi kalau ada pilihan antara "cheap" dan "inexpensive" untuk formal context, choose "inexpensive"!Precision: Academic Words Are More Specific

Academic vocabulary itu nggak cuma formal, tapi juga lebih precise (tepat/spesifik).

Example 1:Casual: "The weather affected the crops."Academic: "The drought adversely affected crop yields."

"Adversely affected" lebih specific daripada just "affected"—jelas menunjukkan negative impact.

Example 2:Casual: "Many people think this way."Academic: "A substantial proportion of respondents subscribe to this viewpoint."

"Substantial proportion" lebih precise dari "many people", dan "subscribe to this viewpoint" lebih formal dari "think this way".

Latin & Greek Roots: The Secret WeaponBanyak academic vocabulary berasal dari Latin dan Greek. Kalau kamu recognize roots-nya, kamu bisa infer meaning kata-kata yang belum pernah kamu lihat sebelumnya!Common Latin RootsRootMeaningExamplesportcarry (membawa)transport, import, export, portabledictsay (berkata)predict, dictate, contradict, indicatescrib/scriptwrite (menulis)describe, prescribe, manuscript, transcribespectsee/look (melihat)inspect, respect, spectator, perspectivemit/misssend (mengirim)transmit, submit, admission, dismissfact/fectmake/do (membuat)manufacture, effect, defect, perfectduc/ductlead (memimpin)produce, reduce, conduct, educate
Common Greek RootsRootMeaningExamplesbiolife (kehidupan)biology, biography, biodegradablegeoearth (bumi)geography, geology, geometrygraphwrite (menulis)graphic, photograph, paragraphphonesound (suara)telephone, microphone, phoneticspsychmind (pikiran)psychology, psychiatry, psychictechskill/art (keterampilan)technology, technical, techniquelogword/study (kata/studi)logic, dialogue, biology (study of life)
Pro Strategy: Kalau ketemu unfamiliar academic word, try to break it down by roots! Misalnya "Biodegradable" = bio (life) + de (down) + grad (step) + able (can be) = dapat dipecah oleh organisme hidupCollocation: Words That Go Together

Academic words punya preferred partners—kata-kata yang naturally sering dipasangkan.

Strong Collocations dengan "conduct":conduct research ✅conduct a study ✅conduct an experiment ✅conduct an investigation ✅conduct a test ❌ (jarang digunakan)conduct work ❌ (tidak natural)Strong Collocations dengan "significant":significant impact/effect/difference/increase ✅significant role/contribution/progress ✅Strong Collocations dengan "demonstrate":demonstrate ability/skill ✅demonstrate evidence/proof ✅demonstrate effectiveness ✅Kenapa penting? Dalam soal synonym, opsi yang punya collocation match dengan kata lain dalam kalimat lebih likely correct!Strategy untuk Master Academic VocabularyThe more you expose yourself to academic writing, the more familiar the vocabulary becomes. Baca Scientific American, The Economist, National Geographic, atau TED Talk transcripts secara rutin.Bikin daftar kata-kata academic yang kamu temui: kata + definisi, synonym formal dan informal, example sentence, dan collocations-nya.Latihan ubah informal → formal. Contoh: "A lot of people get sick from bad food" → "Numerous individuals contract illnesses from contaminated food."Force yourself to use academic words when writing. Practice makes permanent! Semakin sering dipakai, semakin natural rasanya.Common Pitfalls dengan Academic VocabularyHati-hati dengan jebakan-jebakan ini!Pitfall #1: Overusing Fancy Words (Thesaurus Syndrome)

Jangan asal ganti semua kata dengan yang fancy! Harus natural dan appropriate.

❌ TOO MUCH: "The individual commenced to ambulate toward the domicile."✅ BETTER: "The person started to walk toward the house."Pitfall #2: Mixing Registers

Don't mix casual dan formal words awkwardly:

❌ MIXED: "The research kinda demonstrates that..." (kinda = casual!)✅ CONSISTENT: "The research demonstrates that..."Pitfall #3: False Friends

Beberapa academic words mirip dengan kata lain tapi beda arti:

Affect (verb: mempengaruhi) ≠ Effect (noun: hasil/dampak)Complement (melengkapi) ≠ Compliment (pujian)Principle (prinsip) ≠ Principal (kepala sekolah/utama)Quick Recognition Checklist

Untuk identify apakah suatu text academic or not, cek hal-hal berikut:

✅ Uses formal vocabulary (obtain vs get, demonstrate vs show)✅ Avoids contractions (do not vs don't, cannot vs can't)✅ Uses passive voice frequently (it is believed that...)✅ Uses hedging language (may, might, possibly, potentially)✅ Cites sources and evidence (according to, research shows)✅ Uses technical/discipline-specific terms✅ Longer, complex sentences dengan multiple clausesRingkasan dan Key TakeawaysAcademic vocabulary bukan monster yang harus ditakuti! Ini cuma language variant yang punya rules dan patterns sendiri. Once you understand the patterns, it becomes second nature.Formal context = Formal vocabulary.
